alternative_allocation.baseline_for_comparison: Hypothetical equal episode-labeling effort across all three sampled rows: one 3-demo/4-query episode each, requiring 21 Racket pair labels. Only two episodes are prequalified by retained evidence; 01dfed2930fa is not reliably qualified before its current lesson ambiguity is repaired.
alternative_allocation.bounded_test: Without changing draw policy, materialize one source-bound 3-demo/4-query episode for each of 4dd7720cba5f and 3108da8bf9e8 using ticket-derived seeds. Cap at 14 Racket labels, 20 reviewer minutes, and two rejected episode attempts per task. Require exact source/rule hashes, seven distinct visible inputs per episode, cross-episode content-ID deduplication, all labels matching Racket, and every query rejected by all declared rivals using only the shared demonstrations.
alternative_allocation.name: triage-before-racket-labeling
alternative_allocation.proposal: Keep the 10% focus and every authoring probability unchanged. Spend the first two episode-evidence units on 4dd7720cba5f and 3108da8bf9e8, which already have source-bound rivals and lesson hooks; spend the third review unit repairing and replaying 01dfed2930fa's mixed-room schedule before any new labels.
alternative_allocation.quality_per_cost_interpretation: Conditional retained-evidence estimate only: the proposal is 1.5x higher in conservatively counted candidate-qualified episodes per Racket label because it defers labeling a schedule with a known ambiguity. A repaired 01dfed2930fa episode could later qualify; reviewer time, rejection rate, prompt length, cache reuse, and actual four-query identifiability are unmeasured.
alternative_allocation.stopping_rule: Stop immediately on source/hash drift, duplicate visible content, any Racket/Python mismatch, any surviving declared rival, or the attempt/time cap. Report the denominator and failure; do not substitute another task, clone a query, weaken the rival set, or change approvals. Do not label 01dfed2930fa until its current ambiguity is repaired and source-bound replayed.

catalog_weight_observation.finding: All three sampled rows carry weight 1.0, yet 01dfed2930fa has zero current authoring probability and is not packet-approved. Weight is not a quality score or admission decision.

coverage_limits.population_claim: Three uniform packet IDs cannot rank training, augmented, bank, ARC-GEN, RE-ARC, or any other provenance. ARC-GEN and RE-ARC were not sampled, so this report makes no quality or volume recommendation about them.

draw_policy.interpretation: Authoring selection uses packet pools and the 10% focus branch; it does not use catalog mix_weight. Catalog weights apply only after dataset eligibility/filtering and therefore do not admit an unapproved record.
